jobs.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . jobs.company: OLR Holdings Ltd trading as DFYNE
jobs.description: Role: Senior Finance Officer Location: DFYNE HQ, 1 Forrest Gate, Uddingston, G71 5PG Work Location: Onsite About You: Are you someone who loves getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger financial picture? Do you enjoy turning numbers into meaningful insight, spotting trends, strengthening controls, and ensuring everything balances exactly as it should? Are you equally comfortable preparing management accounts, analysing variances, managing fixed assets, and rolling up your sleeves to process invoices and reconcile supplier accounts? If you're highly organised, commercially aware, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, DFYNE may be the place for you. About DFYNE: A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to be sat here reading an essay of corporate “about us” spiel…. Seriously, how’re you able to really get under the skin of what we’re about from a few words on a screen. So why don’t you have a look and see what we’re all about for yourself - www.dfyne.com. About the role - DFYNE Your Career: First off, it's best I introduce myself (person behind the keyboard here). Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF). MUF berdiri secara resmi pada tanggal 21 Januari 2015 dan telah terdaftar serta diawasi oleh Regulator Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 29/ POJK.05/2014. Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) merupakan perusahaan pembiayaan dimana merupakan salah satu anak perusahaan bank terbesar di Indonesia, yaitu Bank Mandiri Tbk. Orientasi bisnis MUF adalah peningkatan volume nasabah beserta pembiayaan yang signifikan, dengan dukungan otomatisasi sistem yang terintegrasi. Lowongan Kerja PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) Saat ini PT Mandiri Utama Finance (MUF) memberikan kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: MUF Management Trainee (MMT) 2027 MUF Management Trainee (MMT) merupakan program pengembangan talenta unggulan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan generasi pemimpin masa depan MUF melalui pembelajaran yang terstruktur, pengalaman langsung di dunia kerja, serta pengembangan kompetensi kepemimpinan dan pemahaman bisnis secara menyeluruh. Dalam program ini, peserta akan mendapatkan kesempatan untuk mengikuti learning, cross-functional exposure, OJT, project implementation, evaluation, dan pengalaman langsung di unit bisnis. Melalui rangkaian pengalaman tersebut, peserta diharapkan mampu membangun leadership, business acumen, analytical thinking, collaboration, agility, dan execution capability sebagai bekal untuk menjalankan peran strategis di MUF. Untuk menghasilkan karya terbaik dan memberikan dampak positif bagi perusahaan, kami mencari talenta muda potensial yang memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, integritas tinggi, growth mindset, kemampuan analitis, inovatif, adaptif, serta antusias untuk terus belajar dan mendorong perubahan berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi : Sarjan

jobs.title: Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager
jobs.description: As Treasury Reporting and Analytics Manager, you will be esponsible for building and leading the Treasury Analytics and Reporting function within the Treasury Center of Excellence (CoE). The role serves as the intelligence engine of the CoE, transforming raw TMS and ERP data into actionable insights on group liquidity, FX/IR risk, debt management, and treasury performance. The role owns the Treasury Management System (TMS) reporting architecture and Power BI analytics layer, and provides decision-support to the Treasury Services Head, Treasurer, and CFO. The role also governs SLA reporting between the Treasury CoE and the Shared Treasury Operations, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, and regulatory compliance across 80+ operating, pre-development, and shell entities and contribute directly to transforming energy for a better world. You will work closely with the Treasury Team to deliver results, create positive community impact, and develop your skills in a supportive, purpose-driven environment.
